Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game. Pakistan took their revenge against Australia after getting a hammering in their previous clash. The team in Yellow, however, plays a dead rubber against the hosts in the 6th match of the tri-series. Do join us for that on Friday at 1000 local (0800 GMT). Meanwhile, you can catch some Test cricket action from the second day of the first Test between West Indies and Bangladesh that starts in a while from now. Till then, Ciao!

Sarfraz Ahmed, the winning skipper, thanks the Almighty before crediting Fakhar Zaman for his innings. Concedes that today's track was a difficult one. Adds that his batters did well to score as many as they did. Now goes on to laud Asif Ali, who displayed a wonderful finishing act with the bat. Now, he focuses on Shaheen Afridi and says that he was backed for a couple of series now. Adds further that the youngster did the job at hand very well, which pleases him.

Fakhar Zaman is chosen to be the Man of the Match. The southpaw says that it's pleasing to get a good start after not getting so in the previous games. Adds that they were expecting more short stuff after their previous clash against Australia and hence were better prepared. States that they had a target to get to about 160-170 and is happy to have got more.

Time for the presentation. Aaron Finch, the captain of the second-best side, is first up. He says that they didn't get going at all today. States that was a 170 wicket but their sloppy fielding ended up conceding much more. Reckons that such one-off losses are a necessity before the finals as one can't keep winning games always.

The Man of the Moment, Shaheen Afridi, has a quick chat with Rameez Raja. He says that the plan was always to perform well for Pakistan whenever he got the opportunity. States that the plan is always to bowl as per the situation. Talks about having small goals in a bid to achieve something great. Reckons that he is pleased to perform any role with the ball and has no such preferences.

All in all, it was a complete performance from the Men in Green. Even after losing the toss they didn't lose the plot. Fakhar Zaman and Asif Ali, along with contributions from other batters helped them to a good score on a greenish wicket. And after that, their bowlers made a mockery of the Aussie chase and stopped them at just 149.

All the other bowlers struck in as well with one wicket each and didn't let any partnership brew. D'Arcy Short yet again struggled to score quickly, thereby piling up the pressure. The top four wickets were removed in the space of just 38 runs, which stopped the Men in Yellow in their stride. After that, it was too much to ask from the lower-order. A lone hand of 37 from Alex Carey was the only surge. However, he alone couldn't have done much to change the final result.

The number one team in the shortest format has come to their regular ways. They have won this game comprehensively and beaten the in-form Kangaroos. It was a complete performance from the Pakistan. All the bowlers put their hands up and cleaned up the Australian batters without much trouble. The new left-arm fast bowling prodigy, Shaheen Afridi, was the star with the ball. He removed both the openers on the way to his career-best figures of 4-0-37-3.
Full in line of the stumps, driven to mid off for a single. PAKISTAN HAVE WON BY 45 RUNS.
Carey gets a bottom edge which goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Similar line and length, driven through long on and two runs are taken.
On a length around middle and off, driven down the ground for a single.
SIX! Too little too late. Short in line of the stumps, Tye pulls it and deposits it to the square leg boundary for half a dozen.
Full on leg, it brushes the pad and goes behind to the keeper.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl the final over.

Chance goes abegging! Short ball in line of the stumps, Tye goes for the pull but skies it. Sarfraz runs to his left towards short fine leg but never looked under control. In the end, he circles around and fails to reach the ball. A single is taken.
Carey backs away but fails to time his pull. Gets it off the inner half through mid on for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven back down to long on for one.
Short in length, pulled away through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads on a length, Tye misses the flick. The ball rolls to the on side and a leg bye is taken.
Fuller in line of the stumps, flicked away in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Shaheen Afridi is back on.
Driven through mid-on by Tye. They pick up a single.
Andrew Tye comes in at no 9.
OUT! Rattled! Amir has his first. Agar moves across but the full pacy delivery evades his bat and crashes into the stumps. Australia lose their 8th wicket and they still need 64 off 13.
Carey walks across his stumps to play it fine. The ball rolls to the on side off the inner half and a single is taken.
Wide outside off, missed by Carey.
Almost a yorker this. Carey does well to dig it out towards mid on for two.
Full outside off, punched to the off side for a run.
Agar moves away from the stumps and lifts it over covers. They pick up a single.
Driven through mid on for another single.
Similar delivery Khan, pushed through cover-point by Agar. The fielder from point runs after it but couldn't stop the batsmen from taking two.
Uppish but safe. A length ball in line of the stumps, Agar stays on the leg side and gets it over the infield. One run added to the total.
On a length around off, the ball hits the inside edge and on to his pads. One run is taken.
Wide! The ball is way wide on the leg side but Carey still goes after it and misses. The Umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Full on a driveable length, creamed through the vacant cover region for a boundary.

SIX! What a cracker! D'Arcy Short should watch Agar's batting. He has creamed that. A length ball on the pads, Agar stays inside the line of the ball and flicks it uppishly. The connection excellent and the ball lands in the deep mid-wicket stands.
Carey has punched the ball off the backfoot. They pick up a single.
Goes across to play the ramp shot but gets hit on his thigh pad. The ball rolls to the on side and one leg bye stolen.
Touch full on off, driven through mid on for another run.
Amir bends his back and bangs this one in middle of the track. Agar looks to pull but only top edges it to mid-wicket. In the end, one run results.
Agar has punched the ball off the back foot.
Ashton Agar comes out to the middle as Mohammad Amir takes the ball in his hand for another spell.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. The short ball has done the trick. A sad run for Stoinis continues in this series. A short ball outside off, Stoinis goes for the pull across the line and only manages to sky it upwards. Asif Ali at mid-wicket steadies himself under it and takes an easy catch.
Angled across Stoinis who misses the cut.
Similar delivery around middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket. One run results.
SIX! Just a short hand jab this and look at the distance on it. Beauty! A back of length ball into the body, Carey takes a couple of steps down the track and heaves it over the long on fence.
Impatience doesn't work! On a length in line of the stumps, Carey gets across to scoop but misses yet again.
Angling away on a length, punched off the back foot through covers for one.
Usman Khan is into the attack.

Excellent finish to the over by Shadab after conceding 12 off the first three balls in the over. He fails to read this googly that is well outside off and misses the attempted sweep. 97 needed off 36 for Australia.
Now Alex is trying too many things and messing up the over. He looks to play the scoop over the keeper but misses and wears it on the pads.
Flatter outside off, Carey attempts a reverse sweep but misses.
SIX! Boom! Alex Carey, where were you so long? Sees the flighted delivery in line of the stumps, gets down on a knee and smashes it well over deep mid-wicket.
Loopy ball around off, lofted towards wide long off for a couple.
FOUR! Well placed. Tossed up in line of the stumps, Carey kneels down and takes it on the full. Sweeps it well past short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Another short delivery in line of the stumps, Stoinis swivels and pulls it to square leg for another boundary. 10 runs off the over and a wicket.
Played through mid-wicket by Stoinis. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
FOUR! Short in line of the stumps, Stoinis pulls it. The ball goes in the air but also in the gap. A boundary earned from the mid-wicket region.
Back of a length on the hips, Carey misses the flick and gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to the on side and a leg bye is taken.
Alex Carey comes out to the middle.

OUT! Timber! Short's stumps are shattered. Afridi has his third. A full ball on leg, it sticks to its line but misses the willow of D'Arcy altogether. He should have sent it out of the park straight down the ground with the shot he played but he ended up missing the line. He is disappointed and rightly so. Pakistan are in the driving seat now.
Full outside off, driven down the ground for a single.
Shaheen Afridi is back for another spell.
On the leg stump, guided to the on side for another run. Just two of this one. Pressure building up on Australia.
Another googly from Khan, Short opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Googly around off, inside edge to square leg for a run.
A touch short in length, Stoinis cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Tossed up outside off, driven through covers for nothing.
Shot but nothing to show for it. A short of length ball on off, Stoinis gets in position and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his right and keeps them down to one.
Hangs back on his crease and blocks it out down the track.
Short and in line of the stumps, Short pulls it through mid-wicket for another single.
Short and guided to third man for a run.
Stoinis shoulders arms to let that one through.
A back of length delivery in line of the stumps, Short punches it of the back foot and changes strike.
Marcus Stoinis is the next batsmen in for Australia.

OUT! Wrong 'un does the trick for Shadab. Not a good first outing for Nic in this series. Shadab tosses this one again around middle and off, Nic comes down the track to hit it down the park but misses it. The ball goes to Ahmed behind the stumps who removes the bails in a jiffy. Australia lose their 4th inside 10 overs.
Short rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Short punches it off the back through covers for another couple of runs.
Flighted around off, driven through covers for two.

Another wrong 'un outside off, Short throws the bat at it. The ball hangs in the air and goes behind the fielder at mid off. Sohail stationed there runs after it but couldn't get to it in time. Two runs taken.
Googly to start the new over. Nic throws his bat at it and manages to get it over point. The fielder from deep comes in and stops the batsmen for a single.
Fuller on the pads, Maddinson misses his flick. The ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Almost a return catch! Length ball around off, Short flatbats it down the ground for one. It goes just past the outstretched arms of the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
This one is hit straight to the man at mid-wicket for nothing.

Good effort from Asif Ali. Maddinson goes deep and works it away through mid-wicket. The fielder stationed there dives to his left, stops it and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A run prevented.
Hurled around off, pushed defensively through covers for one.
Usman Khan comes for a bowl from the other end.
This time, D'Arcy drives it through covers and retains strike.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Short pushes it back towards the bowler off the inner half.
Short gets forward and taps it towards point for nothing.
Flatter wrong 'un outside off, Short goes deep in the crease to cut it but misses.
Floated on the pads, worked away through square leg for one.
Tossed up around middle and leg, driven down to long on for one.
Shadab Khan comes for a bowl.
And opens his account by guiding the length ball through the mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Wide! Wide outside off stump, Nic leaves it alone. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Nic Maddinson comes out to the middle.

OUT! Plumb! The Big Show is gone and Afridi rejoices once again. A full length ball around middle, it pitches and crashes into his back pad as  Maxwell looks to play it to the on side but misses. The bowler appeals and the umpire obliges by raising the dreaded finger. Australia still need 146 off 79 balls.
On a length in line of the stumps, played to mid-wicket for nothing.
And this one cuts him in two. Whatta ball! A back of length pitching on middle and angling away. Maxwell looks to play it through the off side but he is beaten inside the line of the ball.
FOUR! Similar length but strays in line. Maxwell pulls it through square leg for a boundary. Second one for him.
A touch short in line of the stumps, Short punches it off the back for a single.
And misses one after a boundary. A length delivery wide outside off, he throws his bat at but misses.  End of a good over from Ashraf, Australia 44/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Similar delivery from Ashraf, Maxwell gets into good position and flicks it to square leg boundary.
On a back of length on the hips, Maxwell tucks it behind for a brace.
Maxwell has punched the ball off the back foot.
Glenn Maxwell is the next batsman in for Australia.

OUT! Head is beheaded! What a ball to get the wicket. A full length delivery in line of the stumps, with the seam pointing towards fine leg. Head goes at it from his crease with hard hands but only manages to get an inside edge. The ball uproots the middle stump and celebrations erupt in the Pakistan camp. A good start by the Men in Green.
Short gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. They pick up a single.
A touch short in line of the stumps, Head pulls it through mid-wicket. A brace results.
Gets behind the line works it for a single to the on side.
Head works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Head starts the proceedings with a good shot. A back of a length ball outside off, Head throws his hands at it and gets it over the point fielder for a boundary.
Travis Head is the next batsman in.

OUT! Gone. First T20I wicket for Afridi and what a wicket to have, an in-form Aaron Finch. He bowls a length ball angling away from the opposition skipper. Finch gets his bat down at an angle but only manages to get an inside edge to the keeper. He is finally dismissed without scoring at least a half century after three matches.
FOUR! Edgy but up and over the infield. A length ball angling away from Finch who throws his bat at it. He gets it off the outside edge of the bat and a four to the third man region.
Shaheen Afridi comes for a bowl.

Another cracker sound off the bat for nothing. Short is hitting them sweetly but not managing to find the gaps. A length ball around off, Short punches it from his crease but straight to the fielder at mid off. He throws it quickly and the bowlers scampers to collect it and stop the batsmen from taking a run. Good end for Pakistan.
Mistimed pull straight to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Punched to mid-wicket. One run results.
Another short ball just outside off, Short goes for the booming pull. The connection isn't right but still goes behind the out-stretched hand of Ashraf. One run is taken.
Finch looks to make some to play the shortish delivery and Asfraf follows him. He still manages to punch it down the ground for a single.
A full ball on the pads, D'Arcy clips it straight to the fielder at square leg. The keeper cries for the throw and stops the batsman for just a single.
On the pads again. Amir isn't following the proper line and he is leaking runs. Short gets it to square leg and steals a single.
Rocks on the back foot and gets a single through the on side.
Similar length on middle, tucked to mid-wicket. One run taken.
An effort from Amir this. Back of a length outside off, Short goes for the cut but misses.
A tad straight on the pads, Finch flicks it to square leg and takes a single.
A touch short in line of the stumps, pulls it to the on side for a single.

FOUR! No half measure from the big man. A fullish delivery touch closer to the off pole, Finch gets his bat straight in line of the delivery and powers it uppishly down the ground. Another boundary towards the long off boundary and 11 runs taken off Ashraf's over.

Two Leg Byes! A touch short in line of the stumps, Finch looks to guide it fine but misses as the bat hits him on his thigh pad. The ball goes towards the square leg region and two runs are stolen off the poor fielding.

FOUR! Bang! He is into it straightaway. A full ball outside off, Finch lines it up and powers it over the infield down the park. The ball lands just inside the long off fence and goes to the boundary.
On a length around off, punched back to the bowler from his toes.
Similar delivery from Ashraf, Short manages to get it to third man with an angled bat and changes strike.
A back of a length to start with, angling away from the left-hander. Short goes for the cut but misses.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl from the other end with the new ball.
Full and angling away well outside off. Finch gets behind that and punches it straight to the man at covers. A decent start for Pakistan.
Angling in on a fuller length, worked away wide of mid on for one.
Fuller around off, pushed towards mid off.
Outside off on a length, cut away straight to backward point.

FOUR! Poor, very poor from Shaheen Afridi! This is hurled on a length outside off, Short camps back and guides it towards third man. Should have been just one. But a lazy effort in the deep means that the ball goes through to the fence. Afridi didn't cover the line of the ball and hence ended up leaking runs. First boundary for the Aussies!
Steams in from over the wicket and lands it full in line of the stumps. Short gets behind the line of the ball and pushes it back towards the bowler off the outer half.

Time for the pursuit! D'Arcy Short and Aaron Finch walk out to the center. Pakistan are seen in a huddle, post which the players jog to their respective spots on the field. Mohammad Amir will have a go with the new ball first-up. A slip in position. Here we go...
